notes:
Summary: Elmbridge SupportWorks is a mid‑sized contact center platform provider (runs SaaS + managed sites for customers). Evaluating Redwood Dedicated to support a 24/7 agent‑assist + ticket summarization POC. Primary driver: predictable, isolated capacity for sustained spikes and strict data residency and audit requirements.

Recent timeline / activity (bulleted CRM style):
- 2025-11-02: Lead created after inbound from webinar (Alicia). Interested in reserved capacity for enterprise customers.
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (Alicia + Marco) — discussed high level topology, integrations (Zendesk, Salesforce, Genesys); Elmbridge asked about canary rollouts and fallback models.
- 2026-02-17: Technical deep dive (Marco + infra + Redwood runtime lead) — confirmed VPC deployment, KMS integration, and audit log retention. Fireflies id ff-20260218.
- 2026-03-02: Architecture review with platform engineering; asked for latency SLOs and throughput estimates (ff-20260302).
- 2026-03-08: Contract RFI sent to Redwood; legal wants data residency clause and indemnity language.

Use case & requirements (copied from notes):
- Workloads: real‑time agent assist (short prompts, context window ~2k tokens), post‑call ticket summarization, automated tool‑calling (search + ticket create), reranking candidate resolutions.
- Latency targets: p95 generation latency <= 250ms for short agent prompts; end‑to‑end tool‑call + DB lookups < 1s; cold‑start for new conversation < 400ms preferred.
- Throughput: baseline 150 req/s during business hours; expected peaks up to 800 req/s during product incidents; must sustain 3000 concurrent open conversations across customers.
- Reliability: 99.9% uptime SLA for inference; graceful degradation to smaller model variants + region failover.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — pricing must show clear unit economics vs self‑host (they expect dedicated pool to reduce burst costs).
- Model preferences: open models with quantized variants acceptable; want Redwood‑verified perf profiles and pinned model versions for rollouts.
- Routing/fallbacks: need automatic fallback to smaller quantized model under sustained overload, and cross‑region fallback for outages.

Security & compliance notes:
- Requires SOC2 alignment, SSO/SAML for team access, KMS integration for customer keys, and 7 year audit log retention for certain enterprise customers.
- Data residency: primary EU customers require EU region processing; Elmbridge wants Redwood Private or VPC tenancy to guarantee isolation for those tenants.

POC plan (agreed):
- 4 week POC scoped: 200 concurrent agents, Zendesk integration, ticket summarization accuracy checks, and stress test to 1k req/s.
- Deliverables: perf report (latency/throughput), cost per 1k messages, regression checks vs baseline model, SLA draft.
- Success criteria: p95 latency <=250ms on agent prompts, 95% reliable tool‑calls in POC window, and cost < 40% of estimated burst spend on current infra.

Quotes / sales snippets:
- "We can't afford surprise cost spikes during incidents — need reserved throughput that behaves predictably." — Elmbridge Head of Platform
- "Audit logs + residency are non‑negotiable for several clients." — Compliance lead (emailed).

Next steps & owner notes:
- Alicia to push SLA draft to Elmbridge legal by 2026-03-12.
- Marco to prepare infra scoping doc (network, peering windows, KMS keys) and schedule provisioning call with infra ops.
- Proposed pilot start: 2026-04-07 pending legal signoff.
